axis: correctness of manner → conduct measured against moral standards

members.tone: The plain name for the standard — approving only in that it marks behavior as correct or appropriate, without the warmth *grace* adds.
Turns propriety outward, joining the sense of what is fitting to consideration for other people, where *decorum* asks only that the form be kept.
Names correctness of manner as formality, so the coolness and the holding back are part of what is described rather than praise of it.
Locates propriety in the visible layer — manners and conduct — commending the observance of form rather than any feeling behind it.
The same formality and propriety of manner as *reserve*, but carried as an unassuming bearing rather than as distance.
The strongest of these because it answers to morality as well as propriety, making it a floor one can be accused of falling below.
